Method of Attack: Weak implementation of JWT’s HMAC secret
Signing tokens with a weak secret
Brute-forcing JWTs to crack weak secrets
Impacted Systems: Applications using JWTs with weak HMAC secrets
Attack Vector: Brute-forcing JWTs to obtain HMAC secret
Crafting valid JWTs with admin privileges
Indicators of Compromise: JWTs signed with weak HMAC secrets
